**Summary of changes**

**[`src/types.ts`](/home/timotej/Documents/bcco/code/overnight/demo-b/src/types.ts:1)** — added at the top:
```ts
export const SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = ['EUR', 'GBP', 'USD'] as const;
```

**[`src/routes.ts`](/home/timotej/Documents/bcco/code/overnight/demo-b/src/routes.ts:4)** — imported `SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES` and added a guard in [`POST /payments`](/home/timotej/Documents/bcco/code/overnight/demo-b/src/routes.ts:18) after the required-fields check:
```ts
if (!SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.includes(currency as typeof SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES[number])) {
  res.status(400).json({ error: `currency must be one of ${SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.join(', ')}` });
  return;
}
```

**[`src/routes.test.ts`](/home/timotej/Documents/bcco/code/overnight/demo-b/src/routes.test.ts:45)** — new test `POST /payments with unsupported currency returns 400` posting `currency: 'JPY'` and asserting `400` + matching error message.
